in_scope.instructions:
EVO Payments, Inc. is a fully integrated merchant acquirer and payment processor. Evo has an international presence that extends across the USA, Canada, Mexico and Europe. EVO Payments International GmbH is the European subsidiary of the EVO Group.
The target market for this company is POS resellers, Integrators and ISVs, B2B merchants and ERP integrators, SMB merchants and eCommerce integrated partners.
Payment solutions include, standalone terminals, semi-integrated payments, online (gateways and web based payments solutions), value added programs and services, hosted solutions for developers, mobile, B2B and ERP integrations.
